fixtures.label: Two orders at one address — both directions, crew work
fixtures.description:
The family's FIRST fixture and the case it exists for: a CROSS-ORDER sheet at ONE address, in BOTH directions at once. `destination:x07P9fuCbGctZmB4zqhg:crew:both` is what `/pick-sheet` composes for a destination bucket, whose gate DEFAULTS to `crew`. Prod orders 988 + 1006, two legs, 339 units, 36 rows.

Six jobs; the first three separate this family from `packing-list` — same source, different audience.

1. THE NULL LEG — `legLabel` reads "Both directions", the arm `packing-list.eta` REFUSES (it accompanies ONE movement, so rendering both doubles every rental line).
2. TWO BUCKET COLUMNS CARRYING VALUES — 8 A-Frame Signs in Reserved against everything else Checked Out. A page where one column holds everything cannot show the seven partition.
3. THE GATE LINE — "Crew work"; both legs are ours to deliver and collect. `packing-list` never prints a gate.
4. BOTH BANNER LEVELS, each on its own count: 2 orders, and 2 DIFFERENTLY-NAMED legs at one address (the operator's own section names — masked to filler here), under a scope line naming the ADDRESS. Seven group banners below.
5. THE BLANK-CELL EXPLANATION, on 7 rows in both its shapes. A booking is aggregate per (order, product, destination): three products repeat across `Suite 503` and `Mezzanine`, four components across the Black and White Pop Up Tents. One occurrence carries the numbers, the rest read "counted under …". The naive `bookings.find(b => b.uid === row.uid_booking)` renders identically and states 105 chairs twice.
6. TWO SERVICE ROWS with no booking — blank cells, blank Total, still rows.

⭐ ONE organization, so the letterhead names the customer. The dangerous arm — a shared stage holding two productions (prod `3100 W Fillmore St`: 30 orders, 16 organizations), where the name leaves the letterhead for the order banner — is covered by nothing yet.

⚠️ No serialized row, so the Stock column is OFF on both fixtures. ⚠️ `scope.name`, `subject` and `destinations[].name` are masked filler.
